items.summary: Add an admin-only backend operation that deletes/removes all existing Service Provider accounts/data from the canister state (at minimum: providerProfiles entries and their provider role assignment), so that client browsing returns zero providers immediately after the reset.

Add an admin-only backend operation to seed a new set of service provider entries that are tied to specific service categories so they only appear when clients browse those categories (and do not appear in unrelated categories).

Add a simple Technical Team (Back-office) UI control that allows an authenticated back-office/admin user to run (1) the provider reset and (2) the provider seeding actions, with clear English confirmation prompts and success/error feedback.
